description.zh: 表现力(热情的/普通的)，影响您的数字人形象的表现幅度。
description.en: Expressiveness (enthusiastic/normal), which affects the degree of expressiveness of your digital human avatar.

description.zh: 是否生成资产。如您仅希望进行图片可用性检测而不生成资产，则选择false。
description.en: Specifies whether to generate assets. If you only want to perform image availability detection without generating assets, set this parameter to false.

description.zh: 上传的图片路径，必须输入。
description.en: The path of the uploaded image. This parameter is required.

description.zh: 包含额外登录认证信息JWT，已废弃。
description.en: JWT containing additional login authentication information. This parameter is deprecated.

description.zh: 背景: 透明/实景色。如果您需要我们进行抠图处理，则选择透明。如果您已经完成了抠图，或者您想保留图片中的背景，则选择实景色。
description.en: Background: transparent or solid color. Select transparent if you require background removal. Select solid color if you have already removed the background or wish to retain the original background in the image.

title.en: Create a no-training-required image-based digital human
